objective: Replace the shipped Prestige Tree Rewritten content with the resource-centered Civ design, including Population and the first four resource tiers.

include: Population base resource; Food, Water, Shelter
Craft and Organization prestige with population/housing retention
Money and Time; Education and Culture investments
Shared labor, sustainable growth, reserve buffers, free construction recovery
Civ interface, isolated save identity, save/runtime safety and focused tests
exclude: Migration or destruction of original ptr saves
Deployment, merge, service activation, native milestone enrollment

acceptance_criteria: Fresh game starts with 5 Population, housing for 8, passive supplies and no inherited content nodes.
Food/Water production and upkeep share one labor budget; growth respects reserves and infrastructure/housing support.
Zero-stock shortages pause growth without deaths and permit labor-only recovery.
Construction and upgrades produce observable effects; either Craft/Organization branch can be earned first.
Prestige preview and actual reset preserve Population, housing, infrastructure and sibling progress.
Money/Time unlock through Craft/Organization; Education/Culture consume resources and improve earlier production.
Civ saves, import/export, denied storage and runtime-fault recovery preserve valid durable data; ptr is untouched.
Keyboard controls, desktop and narrow-screen journeys work with truthful status and no runtime errors.
Balance policies legally reach the new resource stages under active and five-minute regular play, with focused regressions and matched rough/fixed observations.
constraints: Source main explicitly approved by user; reconciled from 0098433b8a18dedbabca8605d96cd40f3e995371 to published d7d260fa66b270aae228dec2183f4df9da508b5f
Preserve upstream licenses and session-bound state ownership.
Validate direct-session artifacts without claiming native lifecycle acceptance.

decisions.question: How should unrelated ptr saves be protected?
decisions.answer: Use the Civ mod identity and key; reject incompatible imports and leave ptr untouched.
decisions.rationale: The request changes the game content; existing unrelated saves cannot be meaningfully converted into this new economy. This preserves them without a legacy runtime.
